**Note on Gaslighting:**
The dialogue above depicts gaslighting, which is a form of psychological manipulation. It involves denying reality, shifting blame, and making the victim question their own sanity or perceptions. In real relationships, this behavior is considered emotionally abusive and unhealthy. If you or someone you know is experiencing this, it can be helpful to speak with a counselor or trusted support network.
